controlGate.note: The label text differs by docs/sr1-decisions.md decision 2 (Segoe UI vs SF), so the switch sits at a different x. The gate compares the switch itself (size and y exact, pixels exact with edge-aa<=32 after translating by dx) and the label's vertical position; dx and the label pixels are reported.
controlGate.labelCentreToleranceReason: measured: the label's vertical centre differs by 0.5 px on every run (Segoe UI Variable Text 13 DIP (G70) vs SF 13 pt, decision 2); was 3 px
controlGate.controlGapToleranceReason: switch: the label's last glyph ('d') has a different right side bearing in Segoe UI and SF, so the ink-to-switch gap measured 23 px on the Mac and 22 px on Windows on every run
